# account currency

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:accountCurrency`](gmeow-accountCurrency.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/accountCurrency>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

The currency(ies) of a financial account, drawn from the open currency reference-frame vocabulary ([`gmeow:frameRealmCurrency`](../individuals/gmeow-frameRealmCurrency.md)). NON-FUNCTIONAL: a single account may hold balances in several currencies (multi-currency fintech accounts).
